steps.say: Alerts tell you when something you care about changes: a reading, a scan, or a funnel.
Open Notifications in the sidebar. | The Alert Feed lists every alert, newest first.
Configure Alert Rules sets what alerts you. | Trend alerts are on to start: when a reading crosses a colour border, and holds at the next close.
Choose how alerts reach you: instant emails, a daily summary at your chosen hour, or both.
Phone and desktop notifications can pop up too. Turn them on for each device.
Then tick that step on the getting-started checklist.
Your Prism scans and funnels have their own alert settings, right on the scan or funnel.
